name: Gilda Hart
source:
Always one to seek out adventure, coming to live in Concordia was the best thing that could've happened to Gilda. A close second is becoming a divorcee—her ex-husband still happens to be her best friend, though. How does that work? That's a story to be told over another gin rickey, if you're willing to listen.

[From [url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/lets-misbehave]itch.io[/url]]
